snippet.title: DIRTNAP - Trailer
snippet.description:
Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.

https://dirtnapgame.com/

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4956300/Dirtnap/
